watches.description: They’re here. Don’t wait! Upgraded to Miyota 9015 Automatic Movement, Ceramic Lumed Bezel, Sapphire Crystal, 200m Water Resistance, and 24 Month Warranty… oh, and of course - 9 stunning dial options! When Signum launched in 2020, we quickly developed a cult following for our dive watch, the Cuda. Ever since then, we've released various iterations of the watch and shipped them to thousands of customers worldwide. We've realised, that there are three things that people immediately identify with when they think of Signum : LUME: Praised by endless reviewers, the Cuda Full Lume continues to outperform any competition for the brightest, and longest-lasting lume on any watch. Mineral Dials: Our other watches feature the use of both natural and man-made materials, such as mother of pearl, abalone, and meteorite. Value For Money: Signum customers love great watches, with unique features, at an incredible price So What Did We Do? We've doubled down on what you love and created our best collection yet. 9 New Dials: We've produced 9 new dial variants (more on them below with images) 4 New Full Lume Variants: Orange, Purple, Lime Green, and Blue! Here’s a peek at the colours now available! CATHEDRAL MOTIF This is our most unique dial yet. An incredible mosaic effect dial, with a huge variation of colours ranging from Light Blue hues to Dark Red. Available in 4 Bezel Configurations (Black Shark Tooth, Black Plain, Blue Shark Tooth, and Blue Plain). ​ CATHEDRAL MOTIF MOP An interesting take on our new Cathedral Motif - for those who like extra depth. For those that like more mystery in their watches, we've developed an extra thin layer of Mother of Pearl, that we carefully lay over the base dial. This gives a really interesting hazy effect that changes as the watch dial interacts with light. ​ ​Available in 4 Bezel Configurations (Black Shark Tooth, Black Plain, Blue Shark Tooth, Blue Plain). BROWN MOP This dial showcases a range of brown shades, from deep, rich tones to subtle, lighter hues, depending on the angle and lighting. Each watch dial is one-of-a-kind, thanks to the distinctive patterns formed by the Mother of Pearl, ensuring that no two watches are exactly alike. ​​Available in 4 Bezel Configurations (Black Shark Tooth, Black Plain, Blue Shark Tooth, and Blue Plain). GREEN PEARL We think this Green dial just makes it a little harder to choose only one! The dial displays a spectrum of green shades, from vibrant emerald to soft, muted tones, changing dynamically with the light and viewing angle. ​Available in 4 Bezel Configurations (Black Shark Tooth, Black Plain, Blue Shark Tooth, and Blue Plain). ABALONE SHELL One of our most popular dial variants - reborn. The Abalone Shell is completely individual to its wearer. Offering vastly different looks in different lighting, this dial can give off rich blue hues, or deep greens... or sometimes a perfect blend of both! watches.description: Please read all details before ordering: Proud to present the Signum Siege Automatic. We have 6 awesome dials, it’s always a lengthy process to prepare the dials. Now completed we are ready to launch! We ship worldwide. The 6 available dial choices are: 1. Full Lume: Our signature full lume dials well known for their strong glow, blue Superluminova BGW9 with the added orange lume chapter ring . 2. Purple, Green or Blue Copper Turquoise: Turquoise is an opaque, mineral that is a hydrated phosphate of copper and aluminium. Copper Turquoise has always been considered a stone of life and beauty which brings good fortune in addition. 3. Red Mother of Pearl: is the term used for the iridescent substance that forms the inner layer of the shell of some mollusks. Mother of pearl has a very distinct multi-colored effect and a faint glow similar to other optically impressive moon-like gemstones. 4. Heat Meteorite: Back in 2020 Signum was the first watch brand to launch a heat treated ionized dial with our Cuda range and was a huge hit. Our dials go through an ionization process of color and heat to give the dial the purple, blue and sometimes orange color depending on the light and angle of the dial. We use genuine Muonionalusta Meteorite and although there are variations of the dial as each one is unique we choose only the best specimens. PLEASE NOTE: Each of the dials we use here are COMPLETELY unique, as they are a natural or chemically altered we have no influence on its actual appearance however we have chosen the best possible pieces and the photos of actual watches used gives you an indication of what to expect. We have 7 awesome new dials, after having personally selected the mineral specimens used, it’s always a lengthy process to prepare the dials. Now completed we are ready to launch! The 7 available dial choices are: 1. Sodalite: is a tectosilicate mineral. It is part of the cubic crystal system and has a waxy luster. It is also part of the sodalite group with other stones like lazurite and hauyne. Sodalite has an opaque transparency and is a rock forming mineral as well. 2. Howlite: is a borate mineral comprised of irregular nodules and a monoclinic structure. Howlite has a porous texture and is also known as Magnesite. Its color scheme is chalky white with dark veins but it can also be colorless. The meaning of Howlite is linked to patience and perspective. 3. Phantom Crystal: is a variety of quartz or "rock crystal", that forms over pre-existing crystals. The included crystal is visible due to some variation in composition making the boundary of the included crystal visible. Phantom-Crystal symbolizes universal awareness. 4.Malachite: is a green copper carbonate mineral. It is part of the monolithic crystal system and has a silky luster. Malachite is often used as an ore of copper. It has an opaque transparency and can have a patterned surface. Malachite is a rich shade of green and its meaning is transformation and positive change. 5. Terahertz: is an ore produced by extracting silica from sand or quartz that was discovered by Japanese scientists a decade ago to have a terahertz vibration frequency which lies between that of microwaves and far infrared light on the electromagnetic spectrum with its frequency ranging from 0.1 to 30THz. Terahertz frequencies are abundant in the universe and correspond to frequencies found in our bodies and are often referred to as the Radiation of Life. 6. Labradorite: is a feldspar mineral. It has a labradorescence which is the meaning behind its name. The crystals are often found in thin and tabular shapes with colors ranging from purple to grey blue, green, yellow, and brown. The mineral has a pearly sheen and some specimens have a schiller effect. Labradorite conveys courage and mysticism. 7. African Bloodstone: is a form of Chalcedony and Jasper, also known as Setonite. It is opaque to translucent green in color, with mottled red and dark green inclusions.It is believed to have got its name from the red spots with which it is peppered, and in some traditions it is regarded as a sacred stone, with the red representing the blood of Christ. PLEASE NOTE: Each of the dials we use here are COMPLETELY unique, we have no influence on its actual appearance however we have chosen the best possible pieces and the photos of actual watches used below gives you an indication of what to expect BUT there will be variances in the color. watches.description: Please read all details before ordering: SCROLL DOWN FOR PHOTOS. Proud to present the Signum Cuda Titanium. With a choice of 48 different combinations to choose from there should be a little something for all of you :) We have 6 awesome new mineral dials, after having personally selected the mineral specimens used, it’s always a lengthy process to prepare the dials. Now completed we are ready to launch! The 6 available dial choices are: 1. Apatite: Apatite is the name of a group of phosphate minerals with similar chemical compositions and physical properties. They are an important constituent of phosphorite, a rock mined for its phosphorus content and used to make fertilizers, acids, and chemicals. Apatite has a relatively consistent hardness and serves as the index mineral for a hardness of five in the Mohs Hardness scale . Specimens with excellent clarity and color are sometimes cut as faceted gemstones . 2. Azurite: Azurite is a copper carbonate hydroxide mineral. Azurite is not a common or abundant mineral, but it is beautiful and its blue color attracts attention. The specimen we have used has a unique mixture of both Azurite (blue) and Malachite (green) 3. Ocean Jasper: Ocean Jasper, also known as Orbicular Jasper or Cellular Jasper, is a very rare variety of Jasper, a silicon dioxide mineral, and a member of the Quartz family. 4. Red Jasper: Red Jasper is a member of the Chalcedony mineral class. It is an opaque version of quartz with a vitreous luster and opaque transparency. Red Jasper has a deep red coloring ranging from bright red to brownish red. The meaning of Red Jasper is grounding, passion, and protection. 5. Yellow Jasper: Yellow Jasper is a combination of Chalcedony and Quartz. It’s an impure silica variety with a smooth surface and opaque transparency. It has different shades of yellow that range from bright yellow to mustard brown. The mustard, burnished, and sandy yellow color of Yellow Jasper is because of the high iron content in the stone. 6. Malachite: Malachite is a green copper carbonate mineral. It is part of the monolithic crystal system and has a silky luster. Malachite is often used as an ore of copper. It has an opaque transparency and can have a patterned surface. Malachite is a rich shade of green and its meaning is transformation and positive change. PLEASE NOTE: Each of the dials we use here are COMPLETELY unique, as they are a natural mineral we have no influence on its actual appearance however we have chosen the best possible pieces and the photos of actual watches used below gives you an indication of what to expect BUT there will be variances in the color.
